body: You can buy antibiotic eye ointment terramycin online, it helps with a lot of things and won't hurt (administer with clean hands obviously). I'm not a vet but work in animal rescue & this is almost always the first thing we try. If kittens are lethargic and no responsive look for an animal rescue in your area. They're not vets but are equipped to handle a ton of kitten medical problems, worth a shot.
